command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not fit: source already defines the standard opcode and three request forms; the missing lookup value is a project input.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use one protected `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x3d <approved-index> [approved-handle-or-id-bytes]` with the exact form required for ordinary/FE/FF lookup.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FE/FF semantics and 10/5 timing remain preserved; dual-path execution is not assumed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform a bounded schema-aware lookup and store only redacted session metadata.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact form selection, sensitivity controls and semantic decoding and removes log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful transport response without correct FE/FF interpretation does not validate session information.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unbounded enumeration or unredacted evidence can disclose active users and management endpoints.

project_override_considerations: A vendor session inventory API is equivalent only if it resolves the same lookup object and exposes matching fields; it must not delete or alter sessions.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master provides opcode and FE/FF request rules, while DeepSeek says exact bytes are unavailable; Master also ambiguously presents both in-band and OOB execution and asks to clear logs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The query forms are clear. Exact lookup, scope and redaction are execution inputs.

review_improvement: Defines a single bounded lookup with form-aware parsing and prevents sensitive inventory from becoming an automatic session-control input.
independent_technical_reasoning: Values 0xFE and 0xFF change the request schema rather than merely selecting special indexes. Supplying the wrong accompanying handle or ID bytes can query the wrong session or yield misleading output, so the evidence must record the selected form and parser while restricting disclosure and follow-on use.
